description: Read the caller's own view: the current user (the API key's identity), their work queue, or their notifications. Pick with method.

limit.description: Page size (1–100, default 25) Used by: notifications.

method.description:
me: Get the authenticated caller's profile: name, email, organization memberships, and per-org role.
work_queue: Get the caller's work queue: prioritized pending tasks, assignments, and action items across every organization they belong to.
notifications: Get the caller's notifications: assignments, comments, status changes and alerts, including risk_acceptance_expired (a risk) and control_validation_due (a control).

unread_only.description: Return only unread notifications (default false) Used by: notifications.

name: scf_user_read
